```sql
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM placed_at) = 2026;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    channel,
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS total_net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    order_date_local >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date_local < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    channel
ORDER BY 
    total_net_revenue DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue,
    SUM(line_count) AS units_sold
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region;
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date_local) BETWEEN 1 AND 3
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date_local) = 2026;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    net_revenue_eur
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    placed_at >= '2026-01-01' 
    AND placed_at < '2026-02-01'
    AND date_format(placed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '2026-01-01'
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(amount_eur) AS total_refunded_eur
FROM analytics.fct_refunds
WHERE refund_month >= '2026-03-01' AND refund_month < '2026-04-01';
```
